all_pre_cta_body_units.exact_old_topic: Use to prepare the tax-registration handoff for a newly established company/business. TAA 21(1) requires a business that becomes potentially liable under a tax law to apply for taxpayer registration. This verifies a tax job; it does not validate the company’s legal incorporation, shareholder/director rules or registry fees. [TAA 21](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/42eb322b-f2a9-48b9-baaf-01c2ade040f5/content). Keep the existing incorporation documents and current registry requirements as inputs rather than assuming a certificate settles tax registration.

all_pre_cta_body_units.exact_old_topic: Identify the actual legal taxpayer, true identity and existing TIN before preparing the application. Do not create a new company tax identity by reusing a shareholder’s TIN. Reconcile the legal name, incorporation evidence, registered/business addresses, activity, contact details and authorized person against source documents. The prescribed application must be accompanied by the prescribed documentary evidence under 21(4); obtain the actual current form rather than invent a fixed attachment list. [TAA 21–22](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/42eb322b-f2a9-48b9-baaf-01c2ade040f5/content). Share-allocation arithmetic below is only a consistency check on supplied records, not a statement of Malawi minimum capital.

all_pre_cta_body_units.disposition: Retained or expanded with cited company-law scope and the unchanged currentness hold.

all_pre_cta_body_units.exact_old_topic: Check for an existing TIN; assemble the current prescribed registration form and documentary identity evidence; resolve inconsistencies; submit through the actual MRA registration channel; retain submission proof; obtain the TIN certificate and verify the legal person/details. Under 22(5), true identity and no existing TIN are conditions to issuance. Use that TIN on tax claims, notices, returns and statements under 23(1). Notify certificate-detail changes in writing within 21 days. Then determine company-income-tax, VAT, payroll/pension and licence obligations separately with their own sources. [TAA 21–23](https://elibrary.rat.gov.mw/server/api/core/bitstreams/42eb322b-f2a9-48b9-baaf-01c2ade040f5/content). The actual registry sequence, portal fields and tax-type activation acknowledgements remain outside this verified handoff.
